description: List every submission on a mission you posted, with each payload, the wallet to pay, settlementState, and a rule-based prescreen with a suggested reading order (shape only, not a quality verdict). Requires the mission's bf_post_ manage key. Use the ids with review_submission.

manageKey.description: Sensitive bf_post_ mission manage key — shown once at post time.

name: list_submissions
title: List submissions on my mission
